description: Draft the QA scope and plain-language Given/When/Then test scenarios for a Jira ticket, built from the full ticket, the decisions made in its comments, and the actual code change read commit by commit (open PR, the ticket's merged PR, the branch against its base, or a named commit range). Saves a Markdown draft under docs/, iterates with the user, then posts it to the ticket as a new Jira comment only after explicit approval. Use on "QA scope for PROJ-123", "what should QA test", "write test scenarios for QA", "hand this ticket to QA", "prep the QA handoff", "gherkin scenarios for this ticket", or when a branch is ready for manual testing — even when the user only names the ticket or says "this branch".
